findings.evidence: Document and actual target bindings require zero host mounts; guard and positive fixture require three. Align the current schema with the documented topology.
Guard omits PID/IPC/device/capability/no-new-privileges assertions promised by the procedure. Require them for both isolated targets.
Source current-observation flag, node UID and CA fingerprint are not required. Explicit historical or missing measurements must refuse.
Authority current-lineage/custody fields are ignored and fingerprints use truthiness. Require typed identities and exact accepted custody/lineage.
Only final approval window is tested; retained attempt window and record containment are omitted. Validate both.
Final acceptance reference does not prove separately required pre-capture scope approval. Add a distinct bound approval checked before record chronology.
Future retainUntil alone accepts less than the required 30 days from creation. Bind creation, retention API agreement and interval for records and payloads.
Payload digest/readback checks omit exact endpoint, bucket, region and object key/prefix. Require destination/version lineage.
Nonempty list does not establish completeness of the eleven existing local tool roles. Require each role and exact file binding.
Cleanup checks omit source temporary, child-process and mount absence. Require those explicit outcomes for owned resources.
Image, engine/context/daemon and capacity qualification are not checked. Require measured identifiers and explicit qualification.
Original launcher inherits Python startup hooks. Preserve it as historical and supply a create-only reviewed launcher using -I -S -B with exact hash checks.
Deep JSON can raise uncaught RecursionError and reads are unbounded. Bound metadata size and sanitize parser resource refusals.
Same verified topology mismatch as B01; independently filed source/mount declarations do not fix inconsistent schemas.
Same verified isolation omission as B02; network=none does not establish host namespace/capability isolation.
Truthiness admits whitespace/non-string authority/source identities and unknown writer identity. Require typed nonempty values.
node.archiveSha256 lacks an independent digest-format check; matching null plaintext digests can pass. Require a SHA-256 value.
Same verified 30-day retention omission as B07.
Pre-verified test gap: bypassing either verification-receipt or immutable-readback check leaves all 13 tests passing. Add complete-envelope negative cases with rehashed references.
Same independently verified zero-versus-three mount contradiction as B01.
Original private bindings pin earlier guard/tests/procedure hashes. Preserve originals and create a reviewed revision after source stabilization; no original timestamp or operational record changes.

notes: Three independent review layers ran with no operational execution.
Findings concern active offline metadata/procedure checks; original production retirement acceptance remains incomplete.
Corrections preserve concurrent edits and sealed originals; no Git index staging or code rollback is authorized.
